mentions.name: jerrysniffs
mentions.description: Credit-based, zero-subscription search service offering Google, Twitter/X, and Reddit search plus URL fetching that returns results as markdown for feeding into LLMs. Accessible via MCP, API, dashboard, and SDK; each $10 purchase provides 15K Google searches, 3K Twitter searches/lookups, 2K Reddit searches, and 15K URL fetches, with credits that never expire and can be stacked. Supports adding more social media sources.
mentions.problem: Search APIs typically rely on subscriptions; this service offers pay-as-you-go credits that never expire instead.
mentions.audience: Developers feeding search results into their LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Zero-subscriptions google + social media search mcp/api/dashboard/sdk.

Every $10 gets you 15K google searches + 3K Twitter search/lookups + 2K Reddit + 15K Url fetches as markdown for feeding to your llm's.
